claims.text: Deep learning potentials can improve determination of melting temperature in multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Deep learning potentials can improve determination of enthalpy of fusion.
Deep learning potentials can improve determination of entropy of fusion.
Deep learning potentials can improve determination of volume change upon melting.
Deep learning potentials can improve determination of liquid thermodynamic properties.
Deep learning potentials can overcome the limited availability of these thermodynamic data.
Deep learning potentials can determine these properties more efficiently than current experimental and computational methods.
Deep learning potentials can determine these properties more accurately than current experimental and computational methods.
Deep learning potentials can accurately describe the atomic structure of high-entropy materials in both solid and liquid states.
Atomic structure and pair correlations provide a mediator for predicting melting behavior and thermodynamic properties.
Accurate representation of solid and liquid structure enables prediction of melting temperature and other thermodynamic properties.
The intervention applies across a large compositional space of high-entropy alloys.
The intervention applies over the temperature ranges encompassing high-temperature solid and liquid states.
Training data availability for deep learning potentials is limited.
Deep learning potentials may produce errors in predicted thermodynamic properties.
The hypothesis can be tested by comparing deep-learning-potential predictions with experimental thermodynamic data.
A significant deviation between predicted and experimental thermodynamic properties would falsify the hypothesis.
